name: Ride-hailing platform
summary: A whole two-sided marketplace: live driver locations, dispatch, surge, trips, payments and payouts
useWhen: Seeing a real-time, two-sided system drawn end to end, from a driver's GPS ping to a weekly payout.
Explaining matching: H3 cells, ETA ranking, one offer at a time, and surge drawing drivers in.
Starting a system-design discussion about a marketplace with live location and money.
watchOutFor: It is a big picture on purpose: present it flow by flow rather than all at once.
Scale numbers and surge multipliers are illustrative; replace them before you reason from them.
Dispatch is held in place and one connector is a portal, so the file is format 29 and needs a current Draft Canvas.
